chunks: And whatever is in it from ʿAlī ibn Ismāʿīl al-Mīthamī, I have narrated it from my father—may Allah be pleased with him—from Saʿd ibn ʿAbdullah, from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥusayn ibn Abī al-Khaṭṭāb, from Ṣafwān ibn Yaḥyā, from ʿAlī ibn Ismāʿīl al-Mīthamī.

key_terms.رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ: A supplicatory honorific meaning: may Allah be pleased with him.
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; indicates the author’s act of narration.
key_terms.عَنْ: From; the transmission marker linking narrators in the sanad/isnad.

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to ʿAlī ibn Ismāʿīl al-Mīthamī in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage gives the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits reports from ʿAlī ibn Ismāʿīl al-Mīthamī. Its significance lies in documenting the chain of transmission in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh and identifying the intermediaries through whom these hadith are received.
